result.summary: The page is mostly clean and well laid out. The main concern is that the Pizza filter chip is selected, but the 'Popular right now' section leads with a ramen restaurant, so the filter may not be applied. Smaller issues include a duplicated delivery-fee label and a dark selected chip that doesn't match the green brand accent. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is selected, but the 'Popular right now' feed shows Tokumaru Ramen Bar first and the other visible content is not pizza-related. The selected filter does not appear to be reflected in the results.
issues.suggestion: Apply the Pizza filter to all sections, or reset the selection to 'All' when showing mixed content. Make the active filter state match the displayed results.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice, once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below.
issues.suggestion: Show the delivery fee once, either as the image badge or in the metadata row, to reduce redundancy.

issues.description: The selected 'Pizza' chip uses near-black fill, which clashes with the green accent used for the promo banner, 'See all' links, and the active nav item.
issues.suggestion: Use the brand green for the selected chip state so the color system stays consistent.
